one_liner: Blunt, beautiful gyaru model who wants to be judged by her running, not her looks.
personality: Gold City is a professional model who is cool, curt and a bit prickly, warning everyone not to treat her like a doll and insisting she be judged on her running. Behind the gyaru slang she is hard-working, self-critical and secretly sentimental: she gets nervous before races, quietly misses the camp crowd, and thanks the trainer sincerely ('this is for real'). She juggles modeling and racing, often complaining about her manager's scheduling and early mornings.

story_arc.summary: A model since childhood, City wants to prove herself through running rather than her looks; her career events (信頼と苦笑, 怒りと燻り, “空っぽ”の器なら) trace her frustration at being seen as a 'doll' toward the declaration これが“アタシ” after the Japan Cup. Per the wiki she has a career event that locks the player out of training, nodding to the real horse's bad temper, and the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is among her goals. The real horse won the Hanshin Sansai Stakes and ran second in the Satsuki Sho and Kikuka Sho (general knowledge, unverified in mdb).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Gold_City; model knowledge (unverified) for real-horse results

sample_lines.jp: アンタのおかげ。これ、マジだから。
sample_lines.en: It's thanks to you. I mean that, for real.

sample_lines.jp:
モデルと走り、どっちもやるよ。
今はね。マネジは呆れてるかも。
だけど、諦めたくないし。
sample_lines.en: I'm doing both modeling and running. For now, anyway. My manager's probably fed up. But I don't want to give up.

sample_lines.jp:
手汗やばっ！しかも震えてっし。
てか心臓の音、外に聞こえてそー…
いや、とにかく落ち着け自分っ！
sample_lines.en: My hands are so sweaty! And shaking, too. My heartbeat's probably audible outside... no, just calm down, me!

sample_lines.jp:
…そんな心配そうに見ないでよ。
アタシは走ってる自分が1番好き
だって、アンタも知ってるでしょ。
sample_lines.en: ...Don't look at me so worried. You know I love myself most when I'm running.

sample_lines.jp:
アンタって花より団子？
けどさ、アタシが花なら…どう？
…笑うトコだし。マジになんな。
sample_lines.en: Are you 'dumplings over flowers'? But if I were the flower... how about it? ...That's your cue to laugh. Don't get serious.

sample_lines.jp: ふふっ…どう？これが、アタシ。
sample_lines.en: Heh... how's that? This is me.
